body:
Advisor 11:30: the reviewer refused #2782 at 4fa3f93956. The rollback and receipt design matches my ruling and is well tested. Full text: ~/ai/aida-worktrees/aida-pr-2782/.aida/review-verdicts/. Fix on a NEW head, round 2 of 2:
1 MAJOR: session_start.rs:2362: the new 'Err(e) if rollback_failed_setup => return Err' arm removes the warm-pool fallback for every 'agent new --spec' launch, so pool-at-capacity hard-fails. Restore the fallback (pool acquire error -> fresh worktree). Rollback applies only to setup THIS launch created. Add a test with the pool at capacity.
2 acquire_claim_receipted: the same-clone early return must still refresh started_at/heartbeat_at/pid/session for the re-claim (or limit the early return to agent new). Add a test.
3 Trace the three BUG-2188 criteria onto the bug2188_* tests.
4 BUG-2168: test that the dry-run/preview paths (--show-context/--no-exec with --cwd) report the explicit cwd.
5 Delete the orphaned comment at agent_launch.rs ~2579/~2849.
Merge origin/main, gate, push, then mail the advisor.
subject: PR-2782 round 1: warm-pool fallback regression (BUG-2188)
